Our business model
BAT Kenya understands its diverse consumers, develops products to meet their preferences, and ultimately
distributes them to over 13 markets in Africa.
Our business model begins and ends with the consumer. Eight key enablers support us in turning powerful
insights into products that meet consumer needs, while engagement with stakeholders helps them benefit
from our sustainable growth.
